name: FC-DLinear (DLinear + freq MLP)
tagline: RevIN-normalised DLinear backbone with a zero-initialised 2-layer GELU MLP correction in the rFFT domain (concat real/imag → MLP → reconstruct → IFFT to pred_len).
diff_from_baseline: Adds a non-linear cross-frequency residual MLP on top of DLinear + RevIN with zero-init so it begins as the DLinear baseline.

name: Multi-scale decomp + transformer/linear fusion
tagline: Series_decomp_multi (k=3,5,7,11) splits into seasonal+trend; seasonal goes through a DataEmbedding + standard Transformer encoder, trend through a DLinear projection, fused by learnable scalar weights.
diff_from_baseline: Replaces single-kernel decomposition with multi-kernel mean (k=3,5,7,11) and combines a Transformer-encoder seasonal branch with a DLinear-trend branch via learnable scalar fusion weights.

name: FCM-RLinear (DLinear + freq channel mix)
tagline: RevIN + DLinear with an additional zero-initialised cross-channel mixing of the top-k seasonal Fourier modes via complex per-mode matrices.
init_recovers: DLinear + RevIN at initialisation (zero freq mix)
diff_from_baseline: Adds K complex cross-channel mixing matrices on the top-K seasonal Fourier modes; trend stays per-channel; init exactly equals DLinear+RevIN.

name: Dual-anchor multi-branch linear
tagline: Channel-wise linear forecaster with three normalisation anchors (level/global/bridge) plus a short-window difference branch, fused by a softmax gate over six per-variable motion statistics and a convex persistence/linear-trend anchor.

key_hyperparams.name: stats dim
key_hyperparams.role: per-variable motion descriptors fed to gate

key_hyperparams.name: anchor switch
key_hyperparams.role: convex blend of persistence vs. linear trend

init_recovers: Persistence (x_L) + uniform-mean linear DLinear-style branches when gate is uniform
diff_from_baseline: Replaces DLinear's single normalisation+season/trend split with three anchor-normalised linear branches plus a differencing branch, fused by per-step softmax over six channel-wise motion statistics and a convex persistence/bridge anchor.
